fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn using STRPluginMessagingAPI. Uses one unified remote scene-anchor pipeline for physical furniture, free-standing and wall scenes. v0.32.1 canonicalizes addon channel names so OCum overlay caches cannot diverge by case, and makes mirror NPC undressing use OStim's native Actor.UnequipItem plus QueueNiNodeUpdate path. Includes mandatory pre-UI consent, native multi-master scene controls, participant-authored alignment, safe orphan cleanup, OCum live synchronization, and coalesced RaceMenu overlay rebuilds.
